findings.detail: The source reports percent of net assets rounded to two decimals, so exact row-level fair-value divided by net-assets identity residuals are expected for small positions.

rationale: The filing's own anchors reconcile: total investments at fair value of 2,651,286 over total net assets of 1,765,624 rounds to the disclosed 150.17% of net assets. The flagged row examples also match the source: Summit K2 Midco reports fair value 89 and 0.01% of net assets, while Essential Services reports fair value 793 and 0.04%; those percentages are rounded display values, not exact identities. The flag is therefore caused by an overly tight identity check against rounded source percentages, not by a data extraction error.
